entries.title: Mitsubishi 1MT1N — factual recognition reconstruction
entries.configuration: 1MT1N factual recognition reconstruction: one Napier Lion tractor engine, three straight wings, one open cockpit, fixed wheels and one centerline torpedo. Wingspan 13.26 m, length 9.78 m. Simplified outline from documented dimensions and contemporary photographs; small tail and rigging details are schematic. Historical carrier torpedo-operation limitations do not change the drawing.

entries.title: Yokosuka Ro-gō Type A — factual recognition reconstruction
entries.configuration: Production Ro-gō Type A with Mitsubishi-built Hispano-Suiza inline engine, three-bay biplane, two open cockpits, two main floats and small tail float. Span 15.692 m and length 10.16 m. New simplified factual reconstruction from the contemporary photograph and published specifications; it is not a surviving factory plan. Both mappings depict this same floatplane.

entries.title: Nakajima Kikka prototype reference — factual recognition reconstruction
entries.configuration: Kikka prototype physical reference for the scenario interceptor: two underslung Ne-20 jets, modestly swept tapered wings unfolded, one framed cockpit and extended tricycle gear. Span 10 m, length 8.1 m per Smithsonian. No Me 262 substitution, cannon, radar or later production equipment is asserted. Source front drawing shows an alternate folded wing; this new sheet consistently uses both wings unfolded.
